notes: This is a 4x2 factorial design (4 biostimulant/Si treatments x 2 cotton cultivars, pooled across varieties). The GT has two rows sharing the same ctrl_mean (0.596175), indicating two treatment arms at the same dose level. GT pair 1100 (Si alone, effect +0.449%) matched precisely to JSON idx 6 — GT units are t ha-1 and JSON units are kg ha-1 (10000x scale difference). GT pair 1101 (effect -0.660%) represents a second arm — likely the biostimulant-alone or Si+biostimulant combination treatment — for which no PROD JSON obs was extracted. The extractor captured RWC and electrolyte leakage (physiological outcomes) for all three non-control treatments, but only extracted PROD for the Si-alone arm.
